words.tr: phrase. 占据最重要的位置；成为最引人注目的部分
words.ex: The photo of her family takes pride of place on her desk.
words.ex_cn: 她家人的照片摆在她书桌上最显眼的位置。
words.en: To be given the most important or prominent position.

words.w: at the other end of the spectrum
words.tr: 短语. 在光谱的另一端；在另一极端；表示与某事物完全相反或截然不同的情况
words.uk: ət ðə ˈʌðə end əv ðə ˈspektrəm
words.us: ət ðə ˈʌðɚ end əv ðə ˈspɛktrəm
words.ex: He loves quiet books, while his sister loves loud movies—at the other end of the spectrum.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢安静的书，而他妹妹喜欢吵闹的电影——处于另一个极端。
words.en: At the opposite extreme of a range of opinions, qualities, or situations.

words.tr: phrase. 在全国范围内；以国家为单位；从全国层面
words.ex: The law applies on a national basis.
words.ex_cn: 这项法律在全国范围内适用。
words.en: Across the entire country; nationally.

words.tr: phrase. 对…感到困惑；苦苦思索；为…伤脑筋
words.ex: I puzzle about why the sky is blue.
words.ex_cn: 我一直在思考为什么天空是蓝色的。
words.en: To think deeply about something in order to understand or solve it.

words.tr: 短语. 仅举一例；只拿一个例子来说
words.ex: To take but one instance, he failed the math test.
words.ex_cn: 仅举一例，他数学考试没及格。
words.en: To give just one example from many possible ones to illustrate a point.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 被迫做某事；不得不做某事
words.ex: He was compelled to tell the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不说实话。
words.en: If you are compelled to do something, you feel that you must do it, often because someone or something forces you to.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑
words.ex: The teacher must take account of each student's speed.
words.ex_cn: 老师必须考虑每个学生的进度。
words.en: To consider or pay attention to something when making a decision or judgment.

words.tr: adj. 因惊吓而目瞪口呆的；吓得发懵的
words.ex: He was stunned with fright when he saw the big dog.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到那只大狗时，他吓得呆住了。
words.en: So shocked or terrified that one is unable to react.

words.tr: phrase. 以……为目的；意图；打算
words.ex: He went to the library with the intention of studying.
words.ex_cn: 他去图书馆打算学习。
words.en: With the intention of is used to indicate that someone does something with a specific purpose or aim in mind.

words.tr: phrase. 承担对……的责任；对……负责
words.ex: He must assume responsibility for his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他必须为自己的错误负责。
words.en: To take on the duty or blame for something.

words.tr: phrase. 承担...的角色；假定...的身份
words.ex: He assumes the role of teacher when his friend needs help.
words.ex_cn: 当他的朋友需要帮助时，他扮演老师的角色。
words.en: To take on or accept a particular position or duty.

words.tr: phrase. 取决于…；以…为转移
words.ex: His decision hinges on the weather tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他的决定取决于明天的天气。
words.en: to depend on something completely for success or continued existence

words.tr: adj. 最受关注的；知名度最高的
words.ex: He is the highest profile athlete in the country.
words.ex_cn: 他是国内知名度最高的运动员。
words.en: Receiving the most public attention and scrutiny.

words.tr: adj. 高调的；引人注目的；受公众广泛关注的
words.ex: He is a high profile athlete in the country.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个国家一位备受瞩目的运动员。
words.en: Receiving significant public attention and scrutiny.

words.tr: phrase. 提高知名度或关注度
words.ex: The charity event helped to raise the profile of the organization.
words.ex_cn: v. 这次慈善活动有助于提高该组织的知名度。
words.en: To increase the level of attention or awareness that something or someone receives.

words.tr: phrase. 被打算用于；旨在为……而做或存在
words.ex_cn: 这本书是为初学者准备的。
words.en: If something is intended for a particular purpose, it has been planned or designed to fulfill that purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 通常；一般而言（表示通常情况下的普遍规律或做法）
words.ex: As a general rule, it's best to avoid eating too much sugar.
words.ex_cn: 通常，最好避免吃太多糖。
words.en: used to say that something is usually true or usually happens

words.tr: 短语，部分归功于；部分由于
words.ex: He succeeded thanks in part to his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功了，部分原因是因为他的努力。
words.en: Due in some degree to; partially because of.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；部分地
words.ex: He succeeded in part because he worked hard.
words.ex_cn: 他部分成功是因为他努力工作。
words.en: To some extent; not completely.

words.tr: n. 电视报道；电视转播
words.ex: The game had full television coverage.
words.ex_cn: 这场比赛有完整的电视转播。
words.en: The broadcasting of events or news on television.

words.w: neutral or partial to one side
words.tr: adj. 中立或偏向一方的
words.uk: ˈnjuːtrəl ɔː(r) ˈpɑːʃl tuː wʌn saɪd
words.us: ˈnuːtrəl ɔːr ˈpɑːrʃl tuː wʌn saɪd
words.ex: The judge must be neutral and not partial to one side.
words.ex_cn: 法官必须中立，不能偏向任何一方。
words.en: Not taking sides; impartial or biased towards one party.

words.tr: phrase. 处于灭绝的危险中；濒临灭绝
words.ex: The panda is in danger of extinction.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫濒临灭绝。
words.en: At risk of no longer existing, especially referring to species.

words.tr: adj. 平稳结束的；平息的；不再活跃的（指情况、情绪等趋于平静）
words.ex: He fell and went flat over the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒了，整个人平躺在地板上。
words.en: To fall or collapse completely.

words.tr: phrase. 免于……的；对……有免疫力的；不受……影响的
words.ex: The company is immune from the effects of the economic downturn.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司不受经济衰退的影响。
words.en: To be protected from or unaffected by something harmful, such as a disease, legal action, or negative consequence.

words.tr: adv. 以新颖的方式；用新奇的方法
words.ex: He solved the problem in a novel way.
words.ex_cn: 他以一种新颖的方式解决了这个问题。
words.en: In an original, innovative, or unconventional manner.

words.tr: v. 开始她的企业；启动她的事业
words.ex: She starts her enterprise next month.
words.ex_cn: 她下个月开始她的企业。
words.en: To begin her own business or commercial venture.

words.tr: n. 解梦；对梦境的解释
words.ex: He is interpreting dream every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在解读梦境。
words.en: The act of assigning meaning to the symbols and events in a dream.

words.tr: v. 赢得一份合同；中标（指通过竞标或谈判成功获得商业合同）
words.ex: He won a contract to build a new school.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了一份建造新学校的合同。
words.en: To be successful in securing a business agreement or project through competition.

words.tr: phrase. 对……感到尴尬或难为情的
words.ex: He is embarrassed about his bad pronunciation.
words.ex_cn: 他因为自己的糟糕发音而感到尴尬。
words.en: To feel ashamed or self-conscious about something one has done.

words.tr: 短语. ……的一种表现形式；……的显现
words.ex: His anger was a manifestation of his fear.
words.ex_cn: 他的愤怒是他恐惧的表现。
words.en: An example or visible sign of a quality, idea, or feeling.

words.tr: adv. 在某种程度上；或多或少
words.ex: He is late to one extent or another every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都会迟到，或多或少。
words.en: To some degree or in some way, but not completely.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；教育；养育；呕出
words.ex: He brought up an important point in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个重要的观点。
words.en: To mention a subject or start to talk about it; to care for a child until they are an adult, often giving them particular beliefs; to educate someone; to vomit.

words.tr: phrase. 与…背道而驰；与…相抵触；违背
words.ex: His opinion runs counter to the teacher's.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与老师的相反。
words.en: If one thing runs counter to another, it is very different from it and seems to conflict with it.

words.tr: phrase. 热情地相信；充满激情地坚信
words.ex: He believes passionately in equal rights for all people.
words.ex_cn: 他坚信所有人应享有平等权利。
words.en: Hold a strong, intense conviction about something.

words.tr: phrase. 反复试验；试错法
words.ex: He learned to fix the bike by trial and error.
words.ex_cn: 他通过反复尝试和错误学会了修自行车。
words.en: A method of discovering something by trying different things until you succeed.

words.tr: adj. 这种类型的；这一种类的
words.ex: This variety of apples is sweet and juicy.
words.ex_cn: 这种苹果又甜又多汁。
words.en: This type or kind of.

words.tr: phrase. 插嘴；打断；超车抢档
words.ex: He cut in while I was talking.
words.ex_cn: 我正在说话时，他插嘴了。
words.en: To interrupt someone who is speaking, or to move into a line of traffic by driving in front of someone else.

words.tr: 短语动词. 说出自己的意见；发表看法
words.ex: Everyone will have their say in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都会在会议上发表自己的意见。
words.en: to express one's opinion or point of view

words.tr: n. 一个不容小觑的力量；一个必须认真对待的对手或因素
words.ex: He is a force to reckon with in the business world.
words.ex_cn: 他在商界是一个不可忽视的力量。
words.en: A person or thing that is powerful and must be taken seriously.

words.tr: phr. 必须认真对待；必须考虑；不可忽视
words.ex: We must reckon with the weather before we go hiking.
words.ex_cn: 我们在去徒步之前必须考虑天气。
words.en: To consider or deal with someone or something that is significant or challenging.

words.tr: prep. 以…为基础；基于…
words.ex: He makes decisions on a basis of facts.
words.ex_cn: 他基于事实做决定。
words.en: Based on a particular principle or method.

words.tr: n. 通胀压力；导致物价持续上涨的经济压力
words.ex: The rising cost of food causes inflationary pressure.
words.ex_cn: 食品价格上涨带来了通胀压力。
words.en: Economic conditions that cause prices to rise continuously.

words.tr: n. 因果关系，指一个事件（原因）导致另一个事件（结果）发生的关系
words.ex: The rain caused a flood, showing a cause and effect relationship.
words.ex_cn: 下雨导致了洪水，这显示了因果关系。
words.en: A logical connection where one event (the cause) leads to another event (the effect).

words.tr: v. 参加英语考试
words.ex: He will sit an English test next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他下周一要参加一场英语考试。
words.en: To take an examination in the English language.

words.tr: 短语. 处于危险中；面临风险
words.ex: His job is at stake if he is late again.
words.ex_cn: 如果他再迟到，他的工作就保不住了。
words.en: If something is at stake, it is being risked and might be lost or damaged if you are not successful.

words.tr: n. 社会性群体动物（指以群体形式生活、具有社会结构和互动行为的动物）
words.ex: Social groups of animals live together for safety.
words.ex_cn: 动物的群体一起生活以求安全。
words.en: Groups of animals that live and interact together in a community.

words.tr: n. 独居动物；指习惯独自生活、不群居的动物
words.ex: Tigers are solitary animals.
words.ex_cn: 老虎是独居动物。
words.en: Animals that live and forage alone, without regular social interaction.

words.tr: 短语动词. 把钱赠送出去；免费送钱；慷慨施舍
words.ex: He gives money away to poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱捐给贫困的孩子。
words.en: To donate or distribute money to others, often for charitable purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 满足需求；符合要求
words.ex: The new factory must meet the demands of customers.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂必须满足客户的需求。
words.en: To satisfy the needs or requirements of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 社会融合；社会整合；指不同群体或个人融入社会主流结构与文化的过程
words.ex: Immigrants need social integration to feel part of the community.
words.ex_cn: 移民需要社会融合才能感到自己是社区的一部分。
words.en: The process by which separate groups are combined into a unified society, especially when this involves people of different races or cultures.

words.w: be put out of use shortly
words.tr: 短语. 很快将被停止使用；不久将被废弃
words.uk: biː pʊt aʊt əv juːs ˈʃɔːtli
words.us: bi pʊt aʊt əv jus ˈʃɔrtli
words.ex: This old machine will be put out of use shortly.
words.ex_cn: 这台旧机器很快就会被停用。
words.en: To be discontinued or made obsolete in the near future.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 被归因于；被解释为（某种原因）
words.ex: His success is put down to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: To attribute something to a specific cause or reason.

words.tr: 短语. 一系列充满活力的；丰富多彩的组合
words.ex: She bought a vibrant array of flowers for her room.
words.ex_cn: 她为房间买了一大束鲜艳的花。
words.en: A wide and lively variety or collection of different things.

words.tr: phrase. 在损害...的情况下
words.ex: He succeeded at the expense of his health.
words.ex_cn: 他成功了，但牺牲了自己的健康。
words.en: If something is done at the expense of someone or something else, it is done in a way that harms them or is unfair to them.

words.w: beauty is in the eye of the beholder
words.tr: 谚语. 情人眼里出西施；美在于观赏者的眼光
words.uk: ˈbjuːti ɪz ɪn ði ˈaɪ əv ðə bɪˈhəʊldə(r)
words.us: ˈbjuːti ɪz ɪn ði ˈaɪ əv ðə bɪˈhoʊldər
words.ex: Some people think modern art is beautiful, while others don't understand it at all. It just goes to show that beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
words.ex_cn: 有些人认为现代艺术很美，而其他人则完全不懂它。这正好说明美是主观的，美在于观者之眼。
words.en: The phrase 'beauty is in the eye of the beholder' means that the perception of beauty is subjective and varies from person to person.

words.tr: phrase. 实施；付诸实践；把…应用到实践中
words.ex: He learned to put his new skills into practice at work.
words.ex_cn: 他学会了在工作中把新技能付诸实践。
words.en: To apply or implement something in a real situation.

words.tr: 短语动词. 指责某人做某事；控告某人做了某事
words.ex: He accused her of stealing his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他指责她偷了他的手机。
words.en: To charge someone with a fault or offense; to blame someone for doing something wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 服从；容易遭受；受制于
words.ex: All students are subject to the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都必须服从校规。
words.en: Likely to be affected by or to experience something.

words.tr: phrase. 不符
words.ex: This phone is incompatible with old chargers.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机与旧充电器不兼容。
words.en: not able to exist or work with another person or thing because of basic differences

words.tr: phrase. 畅所欲言；打开；开放
words.ex: Please open up and tell me how you really feel.
words.ex_cn: 请畅所欲言，告诉我你真正的感受。
words.en: To make something available or accessible; to start or begin something.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.tr: phrase. 呈现；承担；接受；较量；雇用
words.ex: The sky takes on a pink color at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出粉红色。
words.en: To undertake or begin to deal with a task or responsibility; to hire someone; to acquire a particular appearance or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 吸收；领会；接待；接受
words.ex: Plants take in sunlight to make food.
words.ex_cn: 植物吸收阳光来制造食物。
words.en: To take something in means to understand it or to absorb it. It can also mean to deceive someone or to make clothes smaller.

words.tr: phrase. 接管；接任；取代
words.ex: He will take over the business next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将接管这家企业。
words.en: To take control of something, especially a company, by buying a majority of its shares or by getting a position of power within it.

words.tr: v. 形成于；在……上形成
words.ex: He fills out the form on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他填写桌子上的表格。
words.en: form on: To develop or take shape on a surface or within a structure.

words.tr: phrase. 曾经；同时；一度
words.ex: At one time, he played soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 曾经，他每天踢足球。
words.en: If something was the case at one time, it was the case during a particular period in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 每次；一次；在某时
words.ex: He can eat one apple at a time.
words.ex_cn: 他一次只能吃一个苹果。
words.en: Indicates the number of items or actions that are involved in a single instance or occurrence.

words.tr: phrase. 在……方面不同；在……上有区别
words.ex: They differ in their favorite colors.
words.ex_cn: 他们在喜欢的颜色上不同。
words.en: To be unlike or distinct from something else in nature, form, or characteristics.

words.tr: phrase. 为…创造条件；为…做好准备；为…奠定基础
words.ex: The warm weather set the stage for a perfect picnic.
words.ex_cn: 温暖的天气为一次完美的野餐做好了准备。
words.en: To prepare or establish the conditions for something to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 伸出；突出；坚持到底；显眼
words.ex: The boy stuck out his tongue at the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩对老师吐了吐舌头。
words.en: If something sticks out, it extends beyond something else. If you stick out part of your body, you extend it away from your body.

words.tr: phr. 逐步淘汰某物；分阶段停止使用某物
words.ex: The school will phase out old textbooks next year.
words.ex_cn: 学校明年将逐步淘汰旧教科书。
words.en: To gradually discontinue or eliminate something, such as a product or policy.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；解决；锻炼；进展（顺利）
words.ex: I can work out the answer with a calculator.
words.ex_cn: 我可以用计算器算出答案。
words.en: If you work out a solution to a problem or mystery, you think about it and find a solution. If you work out the answer to a mathematical problem, you calculate it. If a plan or situation works out, it happens or progresses in a particular way.

words.tr: phr. 动身去某地；出发前往
words.ex: They head out to the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们放学后动身去公园。
words.en: To begin a journey or travel to a specific destination.

words.tr: phr. 精心筹划某事；详细安排某事；把某事规划出来
words.ex: He plans out his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都规划好他的作业。
words.en: To carefully arrange or devise a plan for something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 抵消某物；使某物无效；中和
words.ex: The two errors cancel each other out.
words.ex_cn: 这两个错误相互抵消了。
words.en: To neutralize or counterbalance the effect of something.

words.tr: phrase. 摆开；展示；布置；安排；投资
words.ex: He will lay out the books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他将把书摆在桌子上。
words.en: To arrange or spread something out in a particular way, especially so that it can be seen or used easily.

words.w: lay out the plot in painstaking detail
words.tr: v. 极其细致地展开/铺陈情节；以一丝不苟的细节呈现故事脉络
words.uk: leɪ aʊt ðə plɒt ɪn ˈpeɪnskeɪfəl ˈdiːteɪl
words.us: leɪ aʊt ðə plɑːt ɪn ˈpeɪnskeɪfəl ˈdiːtəl
words.ex: He laid out the plot in painstaking detail.
words.ex_cn: 他详尽而细致地铺陈了故事情节。
words.en: To describe the storyline of a narrative with meticulous and thorough precision.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；发出；发表；用尽
words.ex: He gives out books to the students.
words.ex_cn: 他把书分发给学生们。
words.en: To distribute or hand out something; to emit or produce something such as a sound or smell; to announce or make something known publicly.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 将某物或某人彻底清除；逼出（隐藏的人或物）；冲洗掉
words.ex: The police flushed the thief out of the building.
words.ex_cn: 警察把小偷从楼里逼了出来。
words.en: To force something hidden or concealed to emerge or be revealed, often through pressure or investigation.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 设法勉强维持或获得某物；艰难地获得或使用某物
words.ex: He ekes out a living by selling vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他靠卖蔬菜维持生计。
words.en: To make a small amount of something last longer than expected through careful use or management.

words.tr: v. 逐渐侵蚀掉；使逐渐消失或损坏
words.ex: The wave eroded out the rock slowly.
words.ex_cn: 海浪慢慢把岩石冲蚀掉了。
words.en: To gradually wear away or diminish something, typically through persistent natural forces or processes.

words.tr: v. 通过投票使某人离任或被驱逐；投票淘汰
words.ex: They will vote out the lazy mayor.
words.ex_cn: 他们会把懒惰的市长赶下台。
words.en: To remove someone from a position or office by voting against them in an election.

words.tr: phrase. 击倒；破坏
words.ex: He knocked out the other player in the boxing match.
words.ex_cn: 他在拳击比赛中击倒了另一名选手。
words.en: To knock someone out means to cause them to become unconscious or to defeat them in a competition.

words.tr: 短语动词. 充分发挥...的潜力；使某人展现出最好的一面
words.ex: Her teacher brings out the best in her.
words.ex_cn: 她的老师激发出她最好的一面。
words.en: To inspire or encourage the most positive qualities or abilities in a person.

words.w: step out in the public arena
words.tr: v. 进入公共领域；公开露面或参与公众事务
words.uk: step aʊt ɪn ðə ˈpʌblɪk əˌrenə
words.us: step aʊt ɪn ðə ˈpʌblɪk əˌrenə
words.ex: He decided to step out in the public arena to speak for clean water.
words.ex_cn: 他决定走进公共领域，为清洁用水发声。
words.en: To enter or participate in public life or activities, especially in a visible or official capacity.

words.tr: v. 解开；拆散；理清（纠结的线、绳等）
words.ex: He tried to ravel out the tangled string.
words.ex_cn: 他试图解开那团乱绳。
words.en: To untangle or unravel something that has become complicated or knotted, often metaphorically.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 稍微打开；撬开；破开
words.ex: He cracks open the door to see who is outside.
words.ex_cn: 他把门打开一条缝，看看外面是谁。
words.en: To open something with a cracking sound, often implying that it is done with some force or effort.

words.tr: v. 整个吞下某物；比喻不加批判地全盘接受（某观点或信息）
words.ex: He swallowed the lie whole.
words.ex_cn: 他全盘接受了那个谎言。
words.en: To accept an idea or statement completely and uncritically, without questioning its validity.

words.tr: phrase. 把……归因于；认为……是由于
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.tr: v. 逐渐喜欢上某种起初不习惯或不喜欢的味道或事物
words.ex: He acquired a taste for coffee after living in Italy.
words.ex_cn: 他在意大利生活后养成了喝咖啡的习惯。
words.en: To develop a liking for something, especially food or drink.

words.tr: adj. 旨在满足；被设计用来满足
words.ex: The chair is designed to meet the needs of old people.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子是为满足老年人的需求而设计的。
words.en: Created or structured specifically to satisfy a particular need, requirement, or purpose.

words.tr: adj. 根深蒂固于……的；深深嵌入……的
words.ex: The habit is ingrained in him from childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这个习惯从童年起就深深植根于他心中。
words.en: Deeply fixed or established in a person's mind or character.

words.tr: phrase. 使突然陷入；投身于；跳入；投入（某活动或状态）
words.ex: He likes to plunge into cold water in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天跳进冷水里。
words.en: To start to do something suddenly and with a lot of energy, often without thinking about it first.

words.tr: n. 一种基于信念而非证据的行为；信德的行为
words.ex: He took the job as an act of faith.
words.ex_cn: 他接受这份工作是出于信念。
words.en: An action or decision based on belief rather than evidence.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有共同之处；有共同点
words.ex: They have something in common because they both enjoy hiking.
words.ex_cn: 他们有共同点，因为他们都喜欢徒步旅行。
words.en: To share similar interests, characteristics, or experiences with someone else.

words.tr: n. 一种因被预言而最终实现的预言；自我实现的预言
words.ex: He believed he would fail, and so he stopped trying — it became a self-fulfilling prophecy.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己会失败，于是不再努力——这成了一个自我实现的预言。
words.en: A prediction that causes itself to become true.

words.tr: phrase. 除了…以外；不包括；绝不是
words.ex: He eats vegetables other than potatoes.
words.ex_cn: 他吃蔬菜，但不吃土豆。
words.en: You use 'other than' after a negative statement to say that the person, item, or thing that follows is the only exception to the statement.

words.tr: n. 某物所值的钱；与所付金额相符的价值；物有所值的东西
words.ex: He bought a toy that was not money's worth of sth.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个不值那个价钱的玩具。
words.en: The value for which something is worth the money spent.

words.tr: v. 让电视保持关闭状态；别打开电视
words.ex: He left the tv off because he wanted quiet.
words.ex_cn: 他把电视关了，因为他想要安静。
words.en: To not turn on the television; to keep it switched off.

words.tr: phrase. 不一定；未必
words.ex: He is smart, but he is not necessarily good at math.
words.ex_cn: 他很聪明，但不一定擅长数学。
words.en: used to say that something is not always true or not always the case

words.tr: phrase. 资本主义社会，一种以私有制为基础、以资本积累和市场经济为主要特征的社会经济体系
words.ex: In a capitalist society, the means of production are privately owned.
words.ex_cn: 在资本主义社会中，生产资料为私人所有。
words.en: A capitalist society is a social and economic system based on private ownership of the means of production and their operation for profit.

words.tr: 短语. 各种各样的；广泛的系列
words.ex: He has a wide array of books in his room.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间里有一大堆书。
words.en: A large and varied assortment of something.

words.tr: phrase. 电影布景；拍摄场地
words.ex: The actors worked on film sets every day.
words.ex_cn: 演员们每天都在摄影棚工作。
words.en: Locations where movies or television programs are filmed.

words.tr: phrase. 磨练某人的技能；提高技艺
words.ex: He practices every day to hone his skills.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习以磨练自己的技能。
words.en: To improve and perfect a skill or talent through practice and effort.

words.tr: phr. 仔细研读；聚精会神地审视某物
words.ex: He pores over his math book every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都仔细研读他的数学书。
words.en: To study or examine something very carefully.

words.tr: 短语：两倍的数量
words.ex: Twice the number is 10.
words.ex_cn: 这个数的两倍是10。
words.en: A quantity that is double the amount of another.

words.w: A is X times as many as B
words.tr: phrase. 表示 a 的数量是 b 的 x 倍
words.uk: ə ɪz ɛks taɪmz æz ˈmɛni æz bi
words.us: ə ɪz ɛks taɪmz æz ˈmɛni æz bi
words.ex: A is 3 times as many as B.
words.ex_cn: A 是 B 的三倍。
words.en: A is x times greater in number than B.

words.tr: 短语. ……的 x 倍大小/数量
words.uk: eks taɪmz ðə saɪz ˈkwɒntɪti ɒv
words.us: eks taɪmz ðə saɪz ˈkwɑːntəti əv
words.ex: The box is x times the size of the ball.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的大小是球的x倍。
words.en: Having a size or quantity that is x times greater than another.

words.tr: phrase. 有…倾向的；易于…的
words.ex: He is liable to make mistakes when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 当他累了的时候，容易出错。
words.en: If someone or something is liable to something, they are likely to experience it or do it.

words.tr: phrase. 转换到；转移到；转向（某种状态、话题、位置等）
words.ex: The company decided to shift to a new location.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定搬迁到一个新的地点。
words.en: to change or move from one position, direction, or focus to another

words.tr: phrase. 落入；陷入；属于
words.ex: He fell into the river by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心掉进了河里。
words.en: To fall into something means to be classified or divided into it, or to start to be in a particular state or condition.

words.tr: adj. 以利润为导向的；受利润驱动的
words.ex: The company is driven by profits.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司以利润为驱动。
words.en: Motivated or controlled by the desire for financial gain.

words.tr: adj. 无关税的；免关税的
words.ex: The goods are tariff free when imported from this country.
words.ex_cn: 这些商品从这个国家进口时免关税。
words.en: A tariff-free trade agreement eliminates import taxes on goods between member countries.

words.tr: n. 自由通行；无阻碍通过
words.ex: The gate is open, giving free passage to all visitors.
words.ex_cn: 门是开着的，所有访客可以自由通过。
words.en: Free passage refers to the right to move through an area or territory without restriction.

words.tr: prep. 在进入高等教育之前
words.ex: He studied hard before entering higher education.
words.ex_cn: 他在进入高等教育之前努力学习。
words.en: Before entering higher education describes the period of study or preparation prior to university or college.

words.tr: phr. 进展到；发展到；进入（下一阶段）
words.ex: He progress to the next level after passing the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在通过考试后晋级到下一阶段。
words.en: Progress to means to advance or move forward to a higher stage or level.

words.tr: phrase. （事件、时间等的）进程，过程；期间
words.ex: Over the course of the year, the company's profits increased significantly.
words.ex_cn: 在这一年的时间里，公司的利润显著增加。
words.en: The phrase 'the course of' refers to the way in which something develops or the direction that something takes over a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 与……相像；与……有相似之处
words.ex: He bear a resemblance to his father.
words.ex_cn: 他和他父亲长得很像。
words.en: If one thing or person bears a resemblance to another, they are similar to each other.

words.tr: n. 稀有气体；惰性气体（指元素周期表中第18族元素，包括氦、氖、氩、氪、氙、氡、鿫等，化学性质极不活泼）
words.ex: Helium and neon are noble gases.
words.ex_cn: 氦和氖是稀有气体。
words.en: Noble gases are a group of colorless, odorless, highly unreactive gases in Group 18 of the periodic table.

words.tr: n. 敏锐的头脑；聪明才智
words.ex: He has sharp brains and solves math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他头脑敏锐，能快速解决数学问题。
words.en: Sharp brains is an informal phrase describing people who are very intelligent or quick-witted.

words.tr: n. 一种矛盾的发展时期；指在发展过程中出现看似矛盾或对立的现象并存的阶段
words.ex: It was a paradoxical time of development, where people had more money but felt less happy.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个矛盾的发展时期，人们有了更多的钱，却感到更不快乐。
words.en: A paradoxical time of development is a period characterized by contradictory or seemingly opposite changes occurring simultaneously.

words.tr: 短语. 驱使肌肉有节奏地收缩
words.ex: Electric signals drive muscles to contract rhythmically.
words.ex_cn: 电信号使肌肉有节奏地收缩。
words.en: To drive muscles to contract rhythmically means to cause muscles to move in a regular, repeated pattern.

words.tr: n. 一套传统习俗；指一系列世代相传的风俗习惯所组成的整体
words.ex: The village has a body of traditional customs passed down for generations.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄有一套传承数代的传统习俗。
words.en: A body of traditional customs refers to a collection of long-established practices and beliefs within a culture.

words.tr: n. 特定的社区；某个既定的社群
words.ex: A given community needs clean water and schools.
words.ex_cn: 一个特定的社区需要干净的水和学校。
words.en: A given community is a specific group of people living in the same area or sharing common interests and characteristics.

words.tr: adj. 类别广泛的；涵盖范围广的
words.ex: This is a broad category of animals.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个广泛的动物类别。
words.en: A broad category is a general classification that includes many different types of items or concepts within it.

words.tr: n. 口耳相传的消息；口头传播的信息
words.ex: He heard about the restaurant by word of mouth.
words.ex_cn: 他通过口口相传知道了这家餐厅。
words.en: A method of spreading information or recommendations through personal conversations and informal networks, rather than through formal advertising or media.

words.tr: phrase. 口头传统；口传文化；通过口头而非书面形式代代相传的故事、习俗、知识等
words.ex: The story is passed down by oral tradition.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事通过口头传统代代相传。
words.en: The unwritten passing of stories, customs, and knowledge from generation to generation.

words.tr: n. 财务报告和记录：指企业或个人的财务相关文件，包括资产负债表、损益表、现金流量表以及会计账簿等，用于反映财务状况和经营成果
words.ex: He checks financial reports and records every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都会查看财务报告和记录。
words.en: Documents that summarize and record a company's financial activities, including income, expenses, assets, and liabilities, for analysis and compliance.

words.tr: v. 预测未来增长；预估未来发展
words.ex: The company will project future growth using current sales data.
words.ex_cn: 公司将用当前的销售数据预测未来的增长。
words.en: Estimate or predict the potential increase in size, scale, or success of something over a period of time.

words.tr: v. 分析盈利的可能性；评估获利潜力
words.ex: He wants to analyze the potential for profit before starting the business.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始生意前想分析盈利的可能性。
words.en: Examine the likelihood of financial gain from a particular activity or investment.

words.tr: n. 招聘工具；用于招募人员或选拔人才的手段或方法
words.ex: The company uses a survey as a recruitment tool.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用调查作为招聘工具。
words.en: A device or method used to attract, identify, and select suitable candidates for employment or membership.

words.tr: n. 印刷广告活动；以报纸、杂志、海报等印刷媒介为载体的系列宣传推广活动
words.ex: The company ran a print advertising campaign last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月开展了一次印刷广告活动。
words.en: A planned series of advertisements in newspapers, magazines, or other printed media to promote a product, service, or idea.

words.tr: n. 挑衅性信息；煽动性言论；激起强烈反应的讯息
words.ex: He sent a provocative message to start a fight.
words.ex_cn: 他发送了一条挑衅的消息来引发争吵。
words.en: A message intended to provoke a strong reaction, often by challenging norms or provoking controversy.

words.tr: phrase. 新闻报道
words.ex: The news coverage showed the big flood.
words.ex_cn: 新闻报道展示了这场大洪水。
words.en: The reporting of news and events in newspapers, on television, or on the radio.

words.tr: 动名词短语. 取消学费
words.ex: The government is abolishing tuition fees for all students.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在为所有学生取消学费。
words.en: The elimination of charges for education, typically at the university level, making it free for students.

words.tr: n. 单人入住（指房间或住宿设施仅供一人使用）
words.ex: He booked a single occupancy room for the night.
words.ex_cn: 他为当晚预订了一间单人房。
words.en: A room or space designed for use by only one person at a time.

words.tr: v. a 正在使 b 恶化；加剧
words.ex: Smoking is exacerbating his lung problems.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟正在加重他的肺部问题。
words.en: a is making b worse or more severe

words.tr: v. 正在恶化；情况或状态逐渐变坏
words.ex: The bridge is deteriorating because of heavy rain.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥因大雨而正在恶化。
words.en: a is becoming worse or declining in quality

words.tr: v. 坚定地陈述；坚决表明
words.ex: He stated firmly that he would not change his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他坚定地表示他不会改变主意。
words.en: to state something in a strong and certain way

words.tr: v. 认为某人是某物；视某人为某种身份或性质
words.ex: They deem him to be the best student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他们认为他是班上最好的学生。
words.en: to consider or judge someone or something to be a particular thing

words.tr: adj. 惊人的上升增长；引人注目的增长幅度
words.ex: His career had a spectacular rise in just two years.
words.ex_cn: 他的职业生涯在短短两年内迅猛增长。
words.en: a sudden and impressive increase or rise

words.tr: 短语动词 + 名词。作为一枚硬币出现；逐渐显现为一种货币形式
words.ex: The coin emerged as a symbol of freedom.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币作为一种自由的象征出现了。
words.en: to become established or recognized as a significant entity

words.tr: phr. 毫无疑问；确定无疑；毋庸置疑
words.ex: He is not in doubt about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个答案毫不怀疑。
words.en: certain or unquestionable

words.tr: v. 向某人连续猛掷（石块、鸡蛋等）；猛烈攻击某人
words.ex: The kids pelted the dog with snowballs.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们用雪球扔狗。
words.en: to throw things at someone repeatedly and aggressively

words.tr: v. 注定某人的命运；使某人的结局无法改变（通常指负面结果）
words.ex: He lied to the judge and sealed his fate.
words.ex_cn: 他对法官撒了谎，从而决定了自己的命运。
words.en: to determine someone's fate, especially in a negative way

words.w: prescribe by the rules of classical drama
words.tr: v. 依照古典戏剧的规则来规定；按古典戏剧法则加以限定
words.uk: prɪˈskraɪb baɪ ðə ruːlz əv ˈklæsɪkl ˈdrɑːmə
words.us: prɪˈskraɪb baɪ ðə ruːlz əv ˈklæsɪkl ˈdræmə
words.ex: The play is prescribed by the rules of classical drama.
words.ex_cn: 这部剧遵循古典戏剧的规则。
words.en: to follow the strict structure and conventions of traditional drama

words.tr: v. 腐化了语言；使语言堕落或变质
words.ex: He corrupted the language with bad grammar.
words.ex_cn: 他用错误的语法污染了语言。
words.en: To distort or degrade the standard or purity of a language through misuse or poor usage.

words.tr: phrase. 在…之前；先于
words.ex: He left home prior to sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 他在日出前离开了家。
words.en: Before a particular time or event.

words.tr: v. 从……到达；自……抵达
words.ex: He arrived from China last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周从中国到达。
words.en: To have come from a particular place or origin.

words.tr: 短语，通常应为 'be blinded by'，意为 v. 被……蒙蔽；因……而看不清事实，例如：被情绪、偏见或强光等所影响而无法正确判断或看清
words.ex: He is blind by the bright light.
words.ex_cn: 他被强光晃得看不见了。
words.en: To be unable to see or perceive something clearly due to a lack of insight or understanding.

words.tr: n. 纯粹的直觉；完全依靠直觉
words.ex: She made the decision by sheer intuition.
words.ex_cn: 她完全凭直觉做出了决定。
words.en: Based solely on instinctive feeling or insight rather than conscious reasoning.

words.tr: phrase. 付款；支付款项
words.ex: He will make payment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会付款。
words.en: To give money in exchange for goods, services, or to settle a debt.

words.tr: phrase. 未能做某事；没有成功完成某事
words.ex: He fails to do his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都未能完成作业。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or you do not succeed in doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.tr: phrase. 有关；涉及
words.ex: This story relates to childhood memories.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事与童年的回忆有关。
words.en: If you relate to someone or something, you feel that you understand them or their feelings or ideas.

words.tr: phr. 提供学习途径；使人们能够获取学习资源
words.ex: The school provides access to learning for all students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为所有学生提供学习机会。
words.en: To make something available for the purpose of gaining knowledge or skills.

words.tr: n. 身心健康；身体与心理的全面健康状态
words.ex: Exercise and sleep help your physical and mental wellbeing.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼和睡眠有助于你的身心健康。
words.en: The state of being physically healthy and mentally sound.

words.tr: phr. 它完全颠覆了我们的理解；它彻底打乱了我们的认知
words.ex: It entirely upset our understanding of the simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 它完全打乱了我们对这个简单数学问题的理解。
words.en: It completely disrupted or overturned our comprehension of a subject.

words.tr: adj. 智力上较不发达的；认知水平较低的
words.ex: He is less intellectually advanced than his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他没有他妹妹那么聪明。
words.en: Having less developed intellectual capacity or sophistication.

words.tr: phr. 维护成本更低；保养费用更低
words.ex: The car's maintenance costs are lower than before.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的维护费用比以前低。
words.en: The ongoing expenses required to keep something in proper working condition are reduced.

words.tr: phrase. 被...委任；被...委托（通常指被正式指派执行某项任务或创作）
words.ex: The artist was commissioned by the city to paint a mural.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家被城市委托绘制一幅壁画。
words.en: To be officially asked to do a particular piece of work or to create something, often by an organization or authority.

words.tr: 短语. 作为一种实体提醒；作为提醒某事的实物象征
words.ex: He wears the bracelet as a physical reminder of his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着这条手链，作为对母亲的实物提醒。
words.en: Something that serves as a tangible reminder of an event, person, or concept.

words.w: present all the evidence for and against
words.tr: v. 提出所有支持及反对的证据；呈交全部正反两方面的证据
words.uk: ˈprezənt ɔːl ðə ˈevidəns fɔːr ænd əˈgenst
words.us: ˈprezənt ɔːl ðə ˈevɪdəns fɔːr ænd əˈɡɛnst
words.ex: The lawyer must present all the evidence for and against the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 律师必须出示所有支持和反对嫌疑人的证据。
words.en: To provide all the arguments and facts supporting and opposing a particular issue or claim.

words.tr: prep. 在所示的历史视角上；就所呈现的历史观点而言
words.ex: On the historical perspective shown, the law changed slowly.
words.ex_cn: 从所展示的历史视角来看，法律缓慢地改变了。
words.en: Based on the viewpoint or interpretation of history that is displayed or considered.

words.tr: phrase. 拼凑
words.ex: He can piece together the puzzle in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 他能在五分钟内把拼图拼好。
words.en: If you piece together the truth about something, you gradually discover it by considering all the separate bits of information you have.

words.tr: phrase. 发展成；逐渐变为（某事物）；开花般地成长为
words.ex: With proper care, the small business will blossom into a large corporation.
words.ex_cn: 在适当的照料下，这家小企业将发展成为一家大公司。
words.en: To develop or grow into something more advanced or mature.

words.tr: v. 使你有资格享受折扣
words.ex: This card entitles you to discounts at the store.
words.ex_cn: 这张卡让你有资格享受商店的折扣。
words.en: To give you the right to receive reduced prices or special offers.

words.tr: v. 不遗余力；竭尽全力；极其用心地做某事
words.ex: He went to infinite pains to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他竭尽全力按时完成了这个项目。
words.en: To make an enormous, often excessive, effort to achieve something.

words.tr: v. 不遗余力；费尽心思；极其用心地做某事
words.ex: He takes infinite pains to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他费尽心思完成作业。
words.en: To make an enormous, often excessive, effort to achieve something.

words.tr: n. 普通的短语；常见的表达方式
words.ex: It is a commonplace phrase to say 'thank you'.
words.ex_cn: 说‘谢谢’是一个常见的表达。
words.en: A very ordinary or overused expression.

words.tr: 短语动词，表示（某个词语或表达）是由某人创造或首次使用的
words.ex: The term was coined by a scientist in 1990.
words.ex_cn: 这个词是由一位科学家在1990年创造的。
words.en: To be invented or first used by a particular person or group.

words.tr: phrase. 使成一体；融入
words.ex: It is important to integrate into the community when you move to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 当你搬到一个新城市时，融入社区很重要。
words.en: To integrate into something means to become part of a group or system, or to make someone or something become part of a group or system.

words.tr: v. 达到全部潜力；充分发挥潜能
words.ex: He works hard to attain the full potential.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以发挥全部潜能。
words.en: To reach the highest level of development or ability.

words.tr: v. 融入其周围环境；与周围环境相协调
words.ex: The cat blends in with its surrounds.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫与周围环境融为一体。
words.en: To look so similar to the surrounding environment that it is difficult to see.

words.tr: phr. 使它成为伪装冠军；使它成为伪装高手
words.ex: The chameleon makes it a camouflage champion.
words.ex_cn: 变色龙让它成为伪装冠军。
words.en: To be the best at hiding or blending in with the background.

words.w: published in monthly or weekly installments
words.tr: phr. 以每月或每周连载的形式出版
words.uk: ˈpʌblɪʃt ɪn ˈmʌnθli ɔːr ˈwiːkli ɪnˈstɑːlmənts
words.us: ˈpʌblɪʃt ɪn ˈmʌnθli ɔːr ˈwikli ɪnˈstælmənts
words.ex: The story was published in monthly or weekly installments.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事以月刊或周刊的形式分期发表。
words.en: Published in regular, recurring parts over time.

words.tr: phr. 根源于；起源于；扎根于
words.ex: His love of music has roots in his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他对音乐的热爱源于他的童年。
words.en: Has its origins or basis in something.

words.w: offer a powerful insight into sth.
words.tr: phr. 对某事物提出深刻见解；为某事物提供强有力的洞见
words.uk: ˈɒfər ə ˈpaʊəfəl ˈɪnsaɪt ɪntuː sth.
words.us: ˈɔːfər ə ˈpaʊərfəl ˈɪnsaɪt ɪn tuː sth.
words.ex: This study offers a powerful insight into human behavior.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究为人类行为提供了深刻的见解。
words.en: Provide a deep and influential understanding of a subject.

words.tr: n. 人工制品的收藏；文物的集合
words.ex: The museum has collections of artifacts from ancient Egypt.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆收藏了来自古埃及的文物。
words.en: Groups of historical or cultural objects gathered together.

words.tr: adj. 无法与…区分的；与…难以分辨的；看起来与…完全相同的
words.ex: The two coins are indistinguishable from each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两枚硬币彼此无法区分。
words.en: Impossible to tell apart from something else.

words.tr: 短语. 对……产生重大影响
words.ex: Too much screen time can have a significant impact upon children's eyes.
words.ex_cn: 过多的屏幕时间会对孩子的视力产生重大影响。
words.en: Have a major effect or influence on something.

words.tr: adj. 专门用于某事物的；特地为……而设的
words.ex: The museum is sth dedicated specifically to ancient art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆专门致力于古代艺术。
words.en: Something created or intended for a particular purpose or person.

words.tr: 短语. 作为致敬；以示敬意
words.ex: He planted flowers as a tribute to his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他种花是为了纪念他的母亲。
words.en: Done as an expression of respect or admiration.

words.tr: prep. 致敬；向……表示敬意
words.ex: They planted trees in tribute to the fallen heroes.
words.ex_cn: 他们种树以纪念阵亡的英雄。
words.en: As a way of showing respect or admiration for someone or something.

words.w: giving small hands-on demonstrations of sth.
words.tr: 短语. 对某事物进行小规模的实践演示；亲自示范某事的小型实操展示
words.uk: ˈɡɪvɪŋ smɔːl ˈhændzɒn ˌdemənˈstreɪʃənz əv sʌmθɪŋ
words.us: ˈɡɪvɪŋ smɔːl ˈhændzɑːn ˌdemənˈstreɪʃənz əv sʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: The teacher is giving small hands-on demonstrations of how to use the microscope.
words.ex_cn: 老师正在做小型的动手演示，教学生如何使用显微镜。
words.en: Providing practical, interactive explanations of something.

words.tr: phr. 出现在某物旁边；与某物同时出现
words.ex: The cat appears alongside the dog in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 猫和狗一起出现在这张照片里。
words.en: Shown or present at the same time as something else.

words.w: the discovery challenges the popular belief
words.tr: 这一发现挑战了流行的观点
words.uk: ðə dɪˈskʌvəri ˈtʃælɪndʒɪz ðə ˈpɒpjələr bɪˈliːf
words.us: ðə dɪˈskʌvəri ˈtʃælɪndʒɪz ðə ˈpɑːpjələr ˈbɪliːf
words.ex: The discovery challenges the popular belief that the earth is flat.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现挑战了地球是平的普遍看法。
words.en: A recent finding questions a widely held opinion.

words.tr: n. 遗传物质；指生物体内携带遗传信息并能传递给后代的物质，如DNA
words.ex: DNA is the hereditary material in most living things.
words.ex_cn: DNA 是大多数生物的遗传物质。
words.en: Genetic information passed from parents to offspring.

words.w: turned to the biological world for inspiration
words.tr: 短语：转向生物界以寻求灵感
words.uk: /tɜːnd tə ðə ˌbaɪəˈlɒdʒɪkəl wɜːld fɔːr ˌɪnspəˈreɪʃən/
words.us: /tɝːnd tə ðə ˌbaɪəˈlɑːdʒɪkəl wɜːrld fɔːr ˌɪnspəˈreɪʃən/
words.ex: He turned to the biological world for inspiration to design a new robot.
words.ex_cn: 他向生物界寻求灵感来设计一种新机器人。
words.en: Sought ideas or solutions from the living world.

words.w: nature had beaten them to it
words.tr: phrase. 大自然已经抢先一步；大自然早已捷足先登
words.uk: ˈneɪtʃə hæd ˈbiːtən ðəm tuː ɪt
words.us: ˈneɪtʃər hæd ˈbiːtən ðəm tuː ɪt
words.ex: Nature had beaten them to it before they could build the wall.
words.ex_cn: 在他们建墙之前，大自然已经抢先做到了。
words.en: Nature had already achieved what they were attempting.

words.w: no engine to spin through the air
words.tr: 短语 没有发动机来在空中旋转；无法在空中产生旋转动力
words.uk: nəʊ ˈendʒɪn tuː spɪn θruː ðə eə
words.us: noʊ ˈɛndʒɪn tu spɪn θru ðə er
words.ex: The plane has no engine to spin through the air.
words.ex_cn: 这架飞机没有引擎在空中旋转。
words.en: No mechanical device to enable flight.

words.tr: 短语. 超级智能是如何实现的
words.ex: How the super-intelligence is implemented remains a mystery.
words.ex_cn: 超级智能是如何实现的仍然是个谜。
words.en: The method by which advanced artificial intelligence is constructed.

words.w: not sufficiently integrated to count as
words.tr: adj. 融合得不够充分而不能被视为……的
words.uk: nɒt səˈfɪʃntli ˈɪntɪɡreɪtɪd tə kaʊnt æz
words.us: nɑːt səˈfɪʃntli ˈɪntɪɡreɪtɪd tə kaʊnt æz
words.ex: The two systems are not sufficiently integrated to count as one.
words.ex_cn: 这两个系统没有充分整合，不能算作一个。
words.en: Not combined closely enough to be considered as one thing.

words.tr: phrase. ……的重要性；……的意义
words.ex: The significance of homework is to help students learn better.
words.ex_cn: 作业的重要性是帮助学生学得更好。
words.en: The importance, meaning, or relevance of something.

words.tr: phrase. 即时满足；立刻获得的满足感
words.ex: He wants instant gratification and gives up when things are hard.
words.ex_cn: 他想要立即得到满足，遇到困难就放弃了。
words.en: Immediate pleasure or satisfaction without delay, often prioritizing short-term desires over long-term benefits.

words.tr: adj. 费力的过程；艰辛的步骤
words.ex: Cleaning the house is a laborious process of washing, sweeping, and organizing.
words.ex_cn: 打扫房子是一个洗、扫和整理的繁重过程。
words.en: A difficult, tiring, and slow procedure or task.

words.tr: v. 逐渐喜欢上，开始欣赏（原本不习惯或不喜欢的事物）
words.ex: He acquired a taste for coffee after living in Italy.
words.ex_cn: 他在意大利生活后爱上了咖啡。
words.en: To develop a liking or appreciation for something over time, especially something initially unpleasant.

words.tr: phr. 依赖自然资本；依靠自然资源与生态系统所提供的可再生及不可再生资源与服务
words.ex: The farm relies on natural capital to grow food.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场依靠自然资源来种植食物。
words.en: Depends on the natural resources and ecosystems it uses.

words.tr: v. 降低服务质量；使服务退化
words.ex: The old system is degrading the services.
words.ex_cn: 旧系统正在降低服务质量。
words.en: Damaging the benefits provided by the environment.

words.tr: v. 净化我们的水；使水变得纯净
words.ex: They are purifying our water with filters.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在用过滤器净化我们的水。
words.en: Cleaning water to make it safe for use.

words.tr: phr. 调节我们的气候；调控我们的气候
words.ex: Trees are helping in regulating our climate.
words.ex_cn: 树木有助于调节我们的气候。
words.en: Controlling or adjusting the Earth's weather patterns and temperature.

words.tr: phr. 降低洪水风险；减少洪灾危险
words.ex: The city is building walls for reducing the flood risk.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正在修建墙体以降低洪水风险。
words.en: Decreasing the danger or likelihood of flooding in an area.

words.tr: 短语动词. 取得好成绩；获得高分
words.ex: He studied hard to get a good grade.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以取得好成绩。
words.en: Achieving a high score or mark in a test or assignment.

words.tr: phr. 把某物赠予/授予某人；向某人展示某物；使某人面临某事
words.ex: The teacher presented him with a prize.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了他一个奖品。
words.en: To give or show something to someone, often formally.

words.tr: phrase. 报告撰写
words.ex: He is doing report writing for his science class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为科学课写报告。
words.en: Report writing is the process of creating a document that presents information in a structured format, often for business, scientific, or technical purposes. It involves researching, organizing, and presenting data and findings in a clear and concise manner.

words.tr: n. 提供的饮食方案；可选择的膳食计划
words.ex: The doctor offer diet advice to help him lose weight.
words.ex_cn: 医生提供饮食建议帮助他减肥。
words.en: To provide or suggest a plan for eating.

words.tr: phrase. 饮食习惯
words.ex: He changed his dietary habit to eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他改变了饮食习惯，多吃蔬菜。
words.en: Dietary habit refers to the habitual decisions an individual or culture makes when choosing what foods to eat.

words.tr: adj. 添加钙的；富含钙的（通常指食品或饮料中额外添加了钙以增强营养价值）
words.ex: The milk is fortified with calcium.
words.ex_cn: 这种牛奶添加了钙。
words.en: Enhanced or strengthened by adding calcium.

words.tr: prep. 在经济衰退期间；在下行阶段
words.ex: Many shops closed in the downturn.
words.ex_cn: 在经济低迷期间，许多商店关门了。
words.en: During a period of economic decline or recession.

words.tr: phrase. 私营产业；私营部门
words.ex: Many jobs are in the private sector.
words.ex_cn: 许多工作在私营产业。
words.en: The part of the national economy that is not under direct government control, including privately owned businesses and industries.

words.tr: phr. 标志着一个新的政治开端；开启新的政治起点
words.ex: The election marked a new political beginning.
words.ex_cn: 这次选举标志着政治上的新篇章。
words.en: To signify or represent the start of a new phase in politics.

words.tr: 短语：a 表示 b；a 意味着 b；a 代表 b
words.ex: a denotes the number of apples in the box.
words.ex_cn: a 表示盒子里苹果的数量。
words.en: A symbol or letter 'a' stands for or represents 'b'.

words.tr: n. 人类的生存所需；人类的食物和营养
words.ex: Water and food are human sustenance.
words.ex_cn: 水和食物是人类的生存必需品。
words.en: Food or nourishment required for survival and health.

words.tr: n. 一根坚固的支柱；强有力的支持者或基础
words.ex: He is a strong pillar of the family.
words.ex_cn: 他是家庭的坚强支柱。
words.en: A fundamental and reliable support or foundation for an organization, idea, or system.

words.tr: phrase. 转接班机；中转飞行
words.ex: I have a connecting flight in Dubai.
words.ex_cn: 我在迪拜有转机航班。
words.en: A connecting flight is a flight that requires passengers to change planes at an intermediate stop before reaching their final destination.

words.tr: n. 检查过程；检验流程；审查程序
words.ex: The inspection process takes one hour.
words.ex_cn: 检查过程需要一个小时。
words.en: A systematic examination or review to check quality, safety, or compliance with requirements.

words.tr: n. 遵守标准；坚持标准
words.ex: The company shows adherence to standards in all its products.
words.ex_cn: 该公司在所有产品中都遵守标准。
words.en: The act of following or sticking strictly to established rules, guidelines, or principles.

words.tr: prep. 被……激怒；因……而激动；受……刺激而加剧
words.ex: His anger was inflamed by unfair words.
words.ex_cn: 他的愤怒被不公平的话语激起了。
words.en: Made more intense, angry, or excited by a particular cause or influence.

words.tr: n. 悬浮液生产；悬架系统制造（根据语境可指工业中的悬浮物质制备或汽车悬架部件的生产）
words.ex: The factory stopped suspension production last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月停止了悬挂部件的生产。
words.en: The temporary stopping or halting of manufacturing or output.

words.w: is a reflection of your intellectual abilities
words.tr: phr. 是你智力能力的反映；体现你的智力水平
words.uk: ɪz ə rɪˈflekʃən ɒv jɔː ɪntəˈlektjʊəl əˈbɪlətiz
words.us: ɪz ə rɪˈflekʃən əv juː ɪntərˈlektʃuəl əˈbɪlətiz
words.ex: This test is a reflection of your intellectual abilities.
words.ex_cn: 这个测试反映了你的智力能力。
words.en: Is an indicator or manifestation of one's mental capacity and cognitive skills.

words.tr: phrase. 供应的；可获得的；特价出售的；正在出售的
words.ex: There are many discounts on offer this week.
words.ex_cn: 本周有很多折扣优惠。
words.en: If something is on offer, it is available for sale or is being provided.

words.tr: n. 认真的考虑；严肃的思考
words.ex: He gave serious consideration to the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他对这份工作邀请进行了认真考虑。
words.en: Careful and serious thought or attention given to a matter.

words.tr: adj. 被描述为……的；以……为特征的
words.ex: The solution is characterized in the manual.
words.ex_cn: 这个解法在手册中有所描述。
words.en: Described, depicted, or presented in a particular way or style.

words.tr: phrase. 与…结合；兼具
words.ex: Mix the flour combine with water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 将面粉与水混合做成面团。
words.en: To join or merge two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.tr: phrase. 以……结束；最后谈到
words.ex: He concluded with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他以微笑结束。
words.en: To bring something to an end or finish it in a particular way.

words.w: have a picture of the world
words.tr: 短语动词. 拥有对世界的某种看法或理解
words.uk: hæv ə ˈpɪktʃər əv ðə wɜːld
words.us: hæv ə ˈpɪktʃɚ əv ðə wɜːrld
words.ex: He has a picture of the world from his travels.
words.ex_cn: 他通过旅行对世界有了自己的看法。
words.en: To hold a belief, understanding, or mental image about the nature of reality.

words.tr: phrase. 被某人想到；出现在某人脑海中
words.ex: It never occurred to me that he would leave.
words.ex_cn: 我从未想到他会离开。
words.en: To come into one's mind as a thought or idea; to be thought of by someone.

words.tr: 短语动词. 增加努力的支出；投入更多精力
words.ex: He adds the expenditure of effort to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他付出努力来完成作业。
words.en: To involve or require the use of physical or mental energy.

words.tr: adj. 顺利的；宽裕的；有钱的
words.ex: He comes from a well-off family and never worries about money.
words.ex_cn: 他来自一个顺利的家庭，从不为钱发愁。
words.en: Someone who is well-off is rich enough to be able to do and buy most of the things that they want.

words.tr: 短语动词. 申领失业救济金
words.ex: He claims unemployment benefits after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后申请失业救济金。
words.en: To formally request and receive financial support from the government when one is out of work.

words.tr: 短语动词. 声称获得王位；夺取冠军头衔
words.ex: He will claim the crown after winning the match.
words.ex_cn: 他在赢得比赛后将赢得王冠。
words.en: To assert one's right to a royal title or position.

words.tr: phrase. 被融入；被整合进；被纳入
words.ex: The new app will be integrated into the school system.
words.ex_cn: 这个新应用将被整合进学校系统。
words.en: To combine or blend something into a whole, often seamlessly.

words.tr: v. 被分成；被分离成
words.ex: The class can be separated into two groups.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级可以分成两组。
words.en: To be divided or split into distinct parts or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 心境；心理状态；精神状况
words.ex: He is in a calm state of mind.
words.ex_cn: 他处于平静的心态中。
words.en: The condition of someone's mental state or mood at a particular time.

words.tr: phrase. 现状
words.ex: He wants to change the status quo.
words.ex_cn: 他想改变现状。
words.en: The status quo is the state of affairs that exists at a particular time, especially in contrast to a different possible state of affairs.

words.tr: adj. 熟知的，通晓的; 饱学
words.ex: He is well-versed in basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他精通基础数学。
words.en: If someone is well-versed in a particular subject, they know a lot about it.

words.tr: n. 成长型基金；增长基金（主要投资于具有高增长潜力的公司股票，以资本增值为目标的共同基金）
words.ex: He invested money in growth funds to earn more later.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱投资于增长型基金，以期日后获得更多收益。
words.en: Investment funds that focus on companies with potential for rapid growth.

words.tr: phrase. 对…起作用；按...行动
words.ex: He acted on the advice and got better.
words.ex_cn: 他按照建议做了，结果好多了。
words.en: To do something as a result of information or advice received.

words.tr: phrase. 在船（车或飞机）上
words.ex: The captain asked the crew to get on board.
words.ex_cn: 船长让船员们上船。
words.en: On board means to be on a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle.

words.tr: phrase. 销售团队；销售队伍；销售人员总称
words.ex: The company trained its sales force last month.
words.ex_cn: 公司上个月培训了其销售团队。
words.en: A sales force is all the people who work for a company, selling its products or services.

words.tr: phrase. 大量的；许多的
words.ex: He spends a great deal of time on homework.
words.ex_cn: 他花大量时间做作业。
words.en: A large amount or quantity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 适合
words.ex: The new shelf does not fit into the corner.
words.ex_cn: 这个新架子放不进角落里。
words.en: If you fit into a group or situation, you seem to belong there because you are similar to the other people involved.

words.w: meant to limit the oversupply of credits
words.tr: phr. 旨在限制学分/信贷的过度供给
words.uk: miːnt tuː ˈlɪmɪt ðə ˌəʊvərˈsʌp laɪt ɒv ˈkredɪts
words.us: mint tuː ˈlɪmɪt ðə ˌoʊvɚˈsʌp laɪt ɑv ˈkredɪts
words.ex: The rule was meant to limit the oversupply of credits.
words.ex_cn: 这项规定旨在限制学分的过度供应。
words.en: Designed or intended to reduce an excessive amount of available credit.

words.tr: n. 核心概念；基本观念；必不可少的概念
words.ex: He learned the essential concepts of math last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年学会了数学的基本概念。
words.en: The fundamental or core ideas that are necessary for understanding a subject.

words.tr: adv. 以任意顺序；按任意次序
words.ex: You can arrange the books in any order.
words.ex_cn: 你可以按任何顺序摆放这些书。
words.en: In a sequence that is not specifically arranged or prescribed.

words.tr: v. 组织或进行会议
words.ex: He will conduct a meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将主持一次会议。
words.en: To hold or carry out a formal discussion or conference.

words.tr: phrase. 珊瑚礁的形成；珊瑚结构的发育过程
words.ex: Coral formation takes many years to grow.
words.ex_cn: 珊瑚的形成需要很多年才能生长。
words.en: A structure built by coral polyps, typically found in warm, shallow seas, consisting of calcium carbonate skeletons that form reefs or atolls.

words.tr: n. 生活社区；有生命的群落；生态群落
words.ex: The village has living communities that help each other.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄有互帮互助的活生生的社区。
words.en: Places where people live together as a group, often sharing facilities or a common purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 生命形式；生物体；活物
words.ex: The planet is believed to host a variety of life forms.
words.ex_cn: 人们相信这个星球上有多种生命形态。
words.en: A life form is any living thing, such as a plant, animal, or microorganism, that is capable of growth, reproduction, and response to stimuli.

words.tr: phrase. 实施；落实；就位；设立
words.ex: The school put in place a new rule for homework.
words.ex_cn: 学校制定了一项新的家庭作业规定。
words.en: To put something in place means to establish or arrange it, or to position it correctly.

words.tr: 短语动词. 源自某物；由某物衍生而来
words.ex: The formula is derived from simple math.
words.ex_cn: 这个公式是从简单数学中推导出来的。
words.en: To originate or develop from a source or origin.

words.tr: n. 进化适应；生物在进化过程中为适应环境而发展出的生理或行为特征
words.ex: Birds have evolutionary adaptations for flying.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类有适应飞行的进化特征。
words.en: Characteristics that have developed over time to help an organism survive and reproduce.

words.tr: v. 被……打扰；因……而烦恼
words.ex: He is not bothered by loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他不被噪音打扰。
words.en: To annoy, worry, or cause trouble to someone.

words.tr: v. 享受成功；获得成就
words.ex: He enjoys success after years of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他经过多年的努力获得了成功。
words.en: To experience pleasure and satisfaction from achieving something.

words.tr: phr. 占据至高无上的地位；主宰；称雄
words.ex: He reigns supreme in the world of chess.
words.ex_cn: 他在国际象棋界居于至高无上的地位。
words.en: To be the most powerful, dominant, or prevalent in a particular area or situation.

words.tr: 短语，用于引出解释或举例，意为“比如”或“正如……那样”
words.ex: He likes coffee, as in black coffee with no sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，也就是不加糖的黑咖啡。
words.en: Used to introduce an example or clarification of a term or phrase.

words.tr: phrase. 在……对面；与……隔街相对
words.ex: The bank is across from the post office.
words.ex_cn: 银行在邮局的对面。
words.en: prep. on the opposite side of something

words.tr: v. 大胆宣称；作出大胆的声明
words.ex: He makes bold claims about winning the race.
words.ex_cn: 他大胆宣称自己会赢得比赛。
words.en: To make confident, often exaggerated statements that may not be fully supported by evidence.

words.tr: phrase. 绝不
words.ex: He is by no means lazy.
words.ex_cn: 他绝对不懒。
words.en: You use 'by no means' to emphasize that something is not true or is definitely not the case.

words.tr: phrase. 远离；搬离；逐渐放弃；摆脱
words.ex: He wants to move away from the noisy city.
words.ex_cn: 他想离开这个嘈杂的城市。
words.en: To stop doing or using something, or to change from one thing to another.

words.tr: v. 对某人有所关注；留意某人；将某人视为目标
words.ex: The hunter have sb sight on the deer.
words.ex_cn: 猎人把目标对准了鹿。
words.en: To have someone in one's line of sight or view, often implying observation or targeting.

words.tr: 短语动词. 已经掌握了某事物；已有某方面的经验（通常指完成或经历过后）
words.ex: He has driving under the belt.
words.ex_cn: 他已经有驾驶经验了。
words.en: To have something as a personal achievement or experience, often gained through effort.

words.tr: 短语动词. 使某事成为既成事实；使某事被顺利完成（常指经历或完成某事以积累经验或取得进展）
words.ex: He got his first job under the belt.
words.ex_cn: 他拿到了第一份工作。
words.en: To achieve, acquire, or complete something, especially something challenging or worthwhile.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对…表示怀疑；使对…产生疑虑
words.ex: The new evidence cast doubt on his story.
words.ex_cn: 新的证据使他的说法受到怀疑。
words.en: To make people uncertain about something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 阐明；使（问题等）较容易理解；揭示
words.ex: The new study helps to cast light on why birds migrate in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这项新研究有助于阐明鸟类为什么在冬天迁徙。
words.en: To provide information that helps to explain or make something clear.

words.tr: phrase. 被引用为；被引述为
words.ex: He was cited as the best student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他被列为班上最好的学生。
words.en: Used as an example or reference in an argument or discussion.

words.tr: v. 下过于奢侈/挥霍的赌注；做出极为铺张的赌博
words.ex: He made extravagant bets on horse races.
words.ex_cn: 他对赛马下了奢侈的赌注。
words.en: Placed large, excessive wagers, often implying recklessness or overconfidence.

words.tr: adj. 要求高的客户；难以满足的顾客
words.ex: The demanding customer asked for a refund.
words.ex_cn: 这位挑剔的顾客要求退款。
words.en: A person who is difficult to please and has high expectations for service or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 开始任务；着手工作
words.ex: He will commence the task tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天开始这项任务。
words.en: To begin or start a piece of work or a specific activity.

words.tr: n. 决策层级；决策水平
words.ex: The team set decision levels for each project phase.
words.ex_cn: 团队为每个项目阶段设定了决策级别。
words.en: Different stages or layers of decision-making within an organization or process.

words.tr: adv. 出乎意料地；不由自主地（通常用于表示某事物尽管自身不愿意或存在障碍，却仍发生了某种积极变化）
words.ex: The old car kept running, despite itself.
words.ex_cn: 这辆旧车尽管自己不太情愿，还是继续运行着。
words.en: Despite its own inherent nature or characteristics; against its own will or logic.

words.tr: phrase. 在运转中；在战斗中
words.ex: The machine is in action.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器正在运转。
words.en: If someone or something is in action, they are doing the activity or work that is typical for them.

words.tr: v. 做决定；作出决策
words.ex: He takes decisions quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快做决定。
words.en: To make choices or judgments.

words.tr: v. 带来多重风险；构成多种危险
words.ex: Smoking can pose multiple risk to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会对你的健康造成多种风险。
words.en: Present several distinct dangers or sources of harm simultaneously.

words.tr: prep. 在……的层面上；与……处于同一水平；达到……的程度
words.ex: His understanding is on the level of a child.
words.ex_cn: 他的理解水平像孩子一样。
words.en: At the same scale or degree as; concerning the specific aspect of.

words.tr: adj. 与……密切相关；与……有良好关联
words.ex: This job is well related to his degree in engineering.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作与他的工程学位非常相关。
words.en: Closely connected or associated with; having a strong relationship to.

words.tr: prep. 在有能力的人手中；由可靠的人负责
words.ex: The project is in competent hands.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目交给了可靠的人。
words.en: In the care or control of someone who is skilled and capable.

words.tr: phrase. 集中于；向某一点会合或聚集
words.ex: Crowds of people converge on the city center for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 人群为庆祝节日聚集在市中心。
words.en: To move towards the same point and come together from different directions; to tend towards a common conclusion or result.

words.tr: n. 身体张力；肌肉紧实度；体格状态
words.ex: He spoke in a physical tone during the debate.
words.ex_cn: 他在辩论中用一种有力的语气说话。
words.en: The manner or quality of one's physical presence, often implying confidence or authority.

words.tr: n. 学校集会项目；指学校定期组织全体师生参加的集会活动计划，常用于传达信息、表彰或开展集体教育
words.ex: The school holds an assemblies program every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 学校每周一举行集会活动。
words.en: A scheduled series of events or activities held at a school, often involving the entire student body.

words.tr: v. 停滞占主导；停滞状态盛行（指缺乏发展或变化的局面持续存在）
words.ex: Stagnation reigns in the small town because no new businesses open.
words.ex_cn: 由于没有新企业开业，这个小镇陷入停滞。
words.en: A state of inactivity or lack of progress is dominant or prevailing.

words.tr: phrase. 声带
words.ex: He hurt his vocal cords by shouting too much.
words.ex_cn: 他因为大喊大叫而伤了声带。
words.en: The pair of folds of mucous membrane in the throat that vibrate to produce sound when speaking or singing.

words.tr: phrase. 对...做出反应
words.ex: He reacts to loud noises by covering his ears.
words.ex_cn: 他听到大声响时会捂住耳朵。
words.en: To respond to something that has happened or been said.

words.tr: 短语. 一些……的碎片；一部分……
words.ex: There are bits of paper on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 地板上有一些纸片。
words.en: Small pieces or amounts of something.

words.tr: n. 承担一项服务；承接服务工作
words.ex: He is undertaking a service for the elderly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为老年人提供服务。
words.en: The act of performing a task or providing assistance, often as a duty or for a specific purpose.

words.tr: n. 一个可行的定义；在特定工作或研究背景下暂时采用的定义
words.ex: We need a working definition to start the project.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要一个实用的定义来开始这个项目。
words.en: A practical, working description of a concept, used for immediate purposes rather than a precise, formal one.

words.tr: adj. 不明显的区别；不明显的差异
words.ex: The distinctions not obvious made the decision hard.
words.ex_cn: 不明显的区别让决定变得困难。
words.en: Differences or contrasts between things are not easily seen or understood.

words.tr: v. 保留可能性；不排除……的可能；给……留有余地
words.ex: He left the possibility open to visit next summer.
words.ex_cn: 他留着明年夏天去参观的可能性。
words.en: To allow for the possibility that something might happen or be true, without ruling it out.

words.tr: phrase. 克服障碍；战胜壁垒；冲破阻力
words.ex: She worked hard to overcome barriers in her career.
words.ex_cn: 她努力工作以克服职业中的障碍。
words.en: To succeed in dealing with or gaining control of something difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 对于…是理想的；对...是最合适
words.ex: This tool is ideal for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具非常适合初学者。
words.en: If something is ideal for a particular purpose, it is perfect for that purpose.

words.tr: n. 疾病的爆发；传染病突发
words.ex: There were outbreaks of diseases after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 洪水之后出现了疾病暴发。
words.en: Sudden, widespread occurrences of illnesses that affect a community or population.

words.tr: phr. 取得有限的成功；成效不大
words.ex: He had limited success in fixing the old car.
words.ex_cn: 他在修那辆旧车时成效有限。
words.en: Achieved only a small amount of success or failed to achieve desired results.

words.tr: v. 将某事理解为某事；把某事物视为某事物
words.ex: I understand love as a strong feeling.
words.ex_cn: 我把爱理解为一种强烈的情感。
words.en: To interpret or consider something in a particular way; to view it as having a specific meaning or nature.

words.tr: n. 做某事的合适场所或正确地点
words.ex: This is the right place to do your homework.
words.ex_cn: 这里是做作业的正确地方。
words.en: The most appropriate or suitable location or situation for performing a particular action.

words.tr: phrase. 加快速度；加快进展
words.ex: The car began to gather pace as it went down the hill.
words.ex_cn: 汽车下山时开始加速。
words.en: To increase in speed or intensity.

words.tr: phrase. 整合资源；集中资源；共享资源
words.ex: The companies decided to pool resources to develop the new technology.
words.ex_cn: v. 这些公司决定集中资源来开发新技术。
words.en: To combine or share resources, such as money, materials, or people, in order to achieve a common goal.

words.tr: prep. 在某人努力的过程中；为了某人的努力
words.ex: He succeeded in his effort to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力通过了考试。
words.en: in sb's effort: in the attempt or endeavor made by someone.

words.tr: phr. 驶向；朝着……方向引导；倾向于某方向
words.ex: He tries to steer toward the right path.
words.ex_cn: 他努力朝着正确的方向走。
words.en: steer toward: to guide or direct something towards a particular direction or goal.

words.tr: phrase. 把…带到；导致；通向
words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.tr: n. 善与恶
words.ex: The story shows good and evil fighting for control.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事展示了善与恶为控制权而斗争。
words.en: good and evil: the moral concepts of right and wrong; the forces of morality and immorality.

words.tr: phrase. 画一条线；划一条线
words.ex: He draws a line on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一条线。
words.en: To create a line by drawing, often with a pen or pencil.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对……产生影响；对……起作用
words.ex: Too much screen time can have an impact upon children's sleep.
words.ex_cn: 过多的屏幕时间会影响孩子的睡眠。
words.en: have an impact upon: to affect or influence something or someone significantly.

words.tr: v. 被授予……而感到荣幸；因……而受到尊敬
words.ex: He was honored with a gold medal for his courage.
words.ex_cn: 他因勇敢而被授予金牌。
words.en: To receive or be granted an honor, award, or recognition.

words.tr: phrase. 无法做到……的；没有能力做……的
words.ex_cn: 他无法解决简单的数学问题。
words.en: If someone is incapable of doing something, they are unable to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 随着时间的推移；随着时间的流逝
words.ex: As time goes on, he becomes more confident.
words.ex_cn: 随着时间的推移，他变得越来越自信。
words.en: as time goes on: as time passes; over a period of time.

words.tr: v. + n. 揭示证据；揭露事实
words.ex: The detective is exposing evidence at the court.
words.ex_cn: 侦探在法庭上展示证据。
words.en: exposing evidence: revealing or making known facts or information that prove something.

words.tr: n. 表明……的证据；显示……的迹象
words.ex: The photos are evidence indicating he was there.
words.ex_cn: 这些照片是表明他曾在那里的证据。
words.en: evidence indicating: facts or signs that suggest or point to a particular conclusion.

words.tr: phrase. 碍事；挡道
words.ex: Don't get in the way when others are working.
words.ex_cn: 当别人工作时，不要挡道。
words.en: If something or someone gets in the way, they prevent you from doing something or make it more difficult for you to do it.

words.tr: 短语. 生命形式发生了改变
words.ex: The form of life shifted after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 生命的形式在风暴后发生了变化。
words.en: form of life shifted: the way of living or the structure of existence changed.

words.tr: phrase. 跌落；下降
words.ex: The book fell off the table.
words.ex_cn: 书从桌子上掉了下来。
words.en: If something falls off, it becomes detached from something to which it was attached.

words.tr: phrase. 崩溃；瓦解；破裂
words.ex: The old chair will fall apart if you sit on it.
words.ex_cn: 如果你坐在那把旧椅子上，它就会散架。
words.en: If something falls apart, it breaks into pieces because it is old or badly made.

words.tr: prep. 在…的射程/范围/覆盖范围内；在…可达的距离内
words.ex: The temperature is in range of 20 to 25 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 温度在20到25摄氏度之间。
words.en: in range of sth: within the area or scope where something can be reached or affected.

words.tr: 介词短语. 在某物的范围之内；在某物可及或可影响的范围内
words.ex: The ball is within range of the goal.
words.ex_cn: 球在球门范围内。
words.en: within range of sth: inside the distance or scope where something can be reached or affected.

words.tr: prep. 在…的射程之外；超出…的范围；不在…的有效距离内
words.ex: The temperature is out range of normal.
words.ex_cn: 温度超出了正常范围。
words.en: Outside the scope or limits of something.

words.tr: 短语. 各种各样的某物；多种多样的某物
words.ex: The store has a wide variety of fruits.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店有各种各样的水果。
words.en: A large and diverse selection of something.

words.w: save against a time of sickness, unemployment or old age
words.tr: v. 为疾病、失业或年老时期储备（储蓄）
words.uk: /seɪv əˈɡenst ə taɪm ɒv ˈsɪknəs, ˌʌnɪmˈplɔɪmənt ɔːr əʊld eɪdʒ/
words.us: /seɪv əˈɡenst ə taɪm ʌv ˈsɪknəs, ˌʌnɪmˈplɔɪmənt ɔr oʊld eɪdʒ/
words.ex: He saves money against a time of sickness, unemployment or old age.
words.ex_cn: 他存钱以备生病、失业或年老时使用。
words.en: To set aside money or resources for future difficulties like illness, job loss, or retirement.

words.tr: phrase. 逃学；旷课
words.ex: He played truant from school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天逃学了。
words.en: If a child plays truant, they stay away from school without permission.

words.tr: phrase. 引发讨论；激起讨论
words.ex: The movie provoke discussion about truth.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影引发了关于真相的讨论。
words.en: To stimulate or initiate a debate or conversation.

words.tr: v. 抵御风浪；在波浪中屹立不倒（常用于比喻面对困难或挑战时保持坚定）
words.ex: He tries to stand up the waves on his surfboard.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在冲浪板上站起来应对海浪。
words.en: To remain stable or resilient despite challenges or opposition.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；抬起；使升高；提拔；激励
words.ex: He raise up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起手来提问。
words.en: To lift or move something to a higher position; to increase the amount, level, or strength of something.

words.tr: phrase. 给...打气；为...加油打气
words.ex: He likes to pump up his muscles at the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在健身房锻炼肌肉。
words.en: To fill something with air or gas using a pump; to make someone feel more excited or enthusiastic.

words.tr: phrase. 药物抗性；耐药性（指病原体或肿瘤细胞对药物作用的抵抗能力）
words.ex: The bacteria show drug resistance after taking antibiotics.
words.ex_cn: 这些细菌在服用抗生素后表现出耐药性。
words.en: The ability of bacteria, viruses, or other pathogens to resist the effects of a medication, making infections harder to treat.

words.tr: 短语. 受…的迷咒控制；被…迷住；着迷于…
words.ex: He was under the spell of the magic song.
words.ex_cn: 他被那首魔法歌曲迷住了。
words.en: Under the influence or control of someone or something, often in a captivating or magical way.

words.tr: n. 救济与测量重建补助金
words.ex: The government gave relief and measurement rehabilitation grants to injured workers.
words.ex_cn: 政府向受伤工人提供了救济和康复测量补助金。
words.en: Financial assistance provided to help with recovery and assessment after an event or condition.

words.tr: 动词短语，意为‘推动一种复苏或重新兴起’，通常指促进某事物（如经济、运动、趋势等）的再次增长或流行
words.ex: Renewable energy is fueling a resurgence in green technology.
words.ex_cn: 可再生能源正在推动绿色技术的复兴。
words.en: Driving or contributing to a revival or renewed interest in something.

words.tr: v. 验证这一主张；核实此说法
words.ex: He will verify this claim with the data.
words.ex_cn: 他将用数据核实这个说法。
words.en: To confirm the truth or accuracy of a statement or assertion.

words.tr: verb. 达到卓越；取得优异成就
words.ex: He achieves excellence in math every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年都在数学上取得卓越成绩。
words.en: To reach a very high standard of performance or quality.

words.tr: 短语. 达到财务地位；实现财务状况
words.ex: He works hard to achieve the financial status he wants.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现他想要的经济状况。
words.en: To attain a desired level of wealth or economic position.

words.tr: phrase. 完全受…控制；对…极度沉迷；成为…的奴隶
words.ex: He is a slave to his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他被手机奴役着。
words.en: To be completely controlled or dominated by something, often to one's detriment.

words.tr: phrase. 努力，尽力
words.ex: She will endeavor to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 她将努力按时完成这个项目。
words.en: To try hard to do or achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 承诺做某事；致力于；投入
words.ex: He wants to commit to learning English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他想承诺每天学习英语。
words.en: To pledge or dedicate oneself to a certain course of action or belief.

words.tr: phr. 集中注意力于…；将关注焦点放在…
words.ex: The teacher wants to center attention on the main idea.
words.ex_cn: 老师希望把注意力集中在主要观点上。
words.en: To focus all attention or interest on a particular subject or person.

words.tr: phrase. 优于某物或某人；比……更优越
words.ex: He is superior to his brother in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上比他哥哥强。
words.en: To be better or more advanced than something else in quality, skill, or value.

words.tr: phrase. 久而久之；随着时间的过去
words.ex: He gets better over time.
words.ex_cn: 他随着时间的推移变得更好。
words.en: If something happens over time, it happens gradually during a long period.

words.tr: n. 运作中的文化遗产；仍在使用或发挥功能的历史遗产
words.ex: He is protecting his working heritage.
words.ex_cn: 他正在保护他的工作遗产。
words.en: The legacy or traditions inherited from one's work or profession.

words.tr: phrase. 要么……要么……；不是……就是……（用于连接两个选择）
words.ex: You can have either tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 你可以选择茶或咖啡。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.tr: phrase. 不辜负；做到；实践（诺言等）
words.ex: He tried hard to live up to his father's expectations.
words.ex_cn: 他努力不辜负父亲的期望。
words.en: To perform as well as or achieve what is expected or promised.

words.tr: phrase. 赶上；逮捕并处罚；（麻烦事）缠上
words.ex: He needs to catch up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他需要赶上他的同学。
words.en: To reach the same standard or level as someone or something else, especially after a period of lagging behind.

words.tr: phrase. 追踪找到；追查到
words.ex: He tried to track down his old friend from school.
words.ex_cn: 他试图找到他以前的学校朋友。
words.en: To find someone or something after searching for them.

words.tr: v. + n. + adj. + n. 揭开一个引人入胜的谜团（尤指情节曲折、充满八卦或戏剧性的悬案）
words.ex: The detective will unravel a juicy mystery next week.
words.ex_cn: 侦探下周将揭开一个引人入胜的谜团。
words.en: To investigate and solve a complex, intriguing, or scandalous puzzle.

words.tr: adj. 受欢迎的；吃香的
words.ex: He is a sought-after teacher in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他是这座城市里备受追捧的老师。
words.en: Something that is sought-after is in great demand, usually because it is of high quality or difficult to obtain.

words.tr: phrase. 风险评估
words.ex: The company does a risk assessment before starting the project.
words.ex_cn: 公司在开始项目前进行风险评估。
words.en: The evaluation or estimation of the likelihood of undesirable events occurring, and the potential impact of such events.

words.tr: phrase. 对…负责的；对…承担责任；是…的原因
words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: Having an obligation to do something, or having control over or care for someone, as part of one's job or role.

words.tr: phrase. 到达（某地），通常用于较大的地点，如城市、国家等
words.ex: They arrive in London tomorrow morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天早上到达伦敦。
words.en: To reach a destination, especially at the end of a journey.

words.tr: phrase. 到达；达成；达到
words.ex: We arrive at the station at 9 o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 我们九点到达车站。
words.en: To reach a destination or to come to a decision or conclusion after consideration.

words.tr: n. 一种强烈的、有选择性的偏好
words.ex: He has a strong selective preference for red apples.
words.ex_cn: 他对红苹果有很强的选择性偏好。
words.en: A strong inclination or bias towards choosing one option over others.

words.tr: phrase. 现存的；存在的；仍然活着的
words.ex: The oldest tree in the world is still in existence.
words.ex_cn: 世界上最古老的树仍然存在。
words.en: Currently existing or being in the present state.

words.tr: phrase. 时间段；时间档；预定的时间区间
words.ex: I have a time slot at 3 p.m. for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 我下午三点有一个会议时段。
words.en: A specific period of time allocated for a particular activity or event.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对…施加控制；控制…
words.ex: The teacher tries to exercise control over the noisy class.
words.ex_cn: 老师试图对吵闹的班级进行管控。
words.en: To have authority or power over something or someone.

words.tr: 短语动词. 变得著名或重要；开始受到广泛关注
words.ex: He came to prominence during the war.
words.ex_cn: 他在战争期间崭露头角。
words.en: To become widely known or famous, especially in a particular field or for a particular reason.

words.tr: phrase. 持有某种观点；怀有某种想法
words.ex: He holds ideas that are different from others.
words.ex_cn: 他持有与别人不同的想法。
words.en: To maintain or adhere to certain beliefs, opinions, or principles.

words.tr: phrase. 分布于；蔓延至；横跨（多个区域或范围）
words.ex: The flowers spread across the field.
words.ex_cn: 花朵遍布整个田野。
words.en: To extend or expand over a wide area or among many people.

words.tr: v. 始于；源自（某一时期）
words.ex: This building dates from the 1800s.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑建于19世纪。
words.en: To have existed or originated from a particular point in time.

words.tr: phrase. 在……方面的专门知识或专长
words.ex: He has expertise in computer programming.
words.ex_cn: 他精通计算机编程。
words.en: Expert skill or knowledge in a particular subject or activity.

words.tr: phrase. + adj. 几乎没有改变的；实质上未变化的
words.ex: The rules have been virtually unchanged for decades.
words.ex_cn: 这些规则几十年来几乎没有任何变化。
words.en: Almost entirely without change; remaining in the same state.

words.tr: phrase. 文化遗产
words.ex: The old temple is part of our cultural heritage.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙是我们文化遗产的一部分。
words.en: Cultural heritage refers to the legacy of physical artifacts and intangible attributes of a group or society that are inherited from past generations, maintained in the present and bestowed for the benefit of future generations.

words.tr: n. 分阶段进行的过程；逐步实施的程序
words.ex: The project follows a phased process to finish each step.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目遵循一个分阶段的过程来完成每一步。
words.en: A process that is carried out in a series of successive stages or steps.

words.tr: v. 采取个性化的方法；根据个人特点或需求制定专属策略
words.ex: The teacher takes an individualized approach to help each student learn.
words.ex_cn: 老师采用个性化的方法帮助每个学生学习。
words.en: To treat each person or situation according to their specific needs or circumstances.

words.w: a critical need for stronger relationships
words.tr: n. 对更牢固关系的迫切需求
words.uk: ə ˈkrɪtɪkəl niːd fɔːr ˈstrɒŋɡə rɪˈleɪʃənʃɪps
words.us: ə ˈkrɪtɪkəl niːd fɔːr ˈstrɔːŋɡɚ rɪˈleɪʃənʃɪps
words.ex: There is a critical need for stronger relationships between teachers and students.
words.ex_cn: 教师和学生之间迫切需要建立更牢固的关系。
words.en: An urgent and essential requirement to build more robust connections.

words.tr: v. 练习他们的台词
words.ex: The actors practice their lines every evening.
words.ex_cn: 演员们每天晚上练习他们的台词。
words.en: To rehearse or memorize spoken parts, typically for a performance.

words.tr: v. 起源于；最初作为……出现
words.ex: This tradition originated as a simple ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于一个简单的仪式。
words.en: To begin or emerge from a particular source or starting point.

words.tr: n. 道路网络；路网；公路网
words.ex: The city has a network of roads to connect all areas.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市有一套道路网络来连接所有区域。
words.en: A system of interconnected routes for travel or transportation.

words.tr: phr. 用某物替换；以…取代…
words.ex: He will replace the old chair with a new one.
words.ex_cn: 他将把旧椅子换成新的。
words.en: To substitute one thing for another; to take the place of.

words.tr: v. 使事物发生变化；打破常规；搅动局面
words.ex: He wants to shake thing up at his new job.
words.ex_cn: 他想在新工作中打破现状。
words.en: To cause significant change or disruption, often in a positive way.

words.tr: adv. 安稳地睡8到9小时
words.uk: ˈsaʊndli slēp fɔːr eɪt tə naɪn ˈaʊəz
words.us: ˈsaʊndli slip fɔr eɪt tu nain ˈaʊərz
words.ex: He soundly sleeps for 8-9 hours every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每晚都安稳地睡8到9个小时。
words.en: To sleep deeply and continuously for a period of eight to nine hours.

words.tr: phrase. 熬夜；不睡觉
words.ex: He stays up late to watch movies.
words.ex_cn: 他熬夜看电影。
words.en: To remain awake and not go to bed.

words.tr: phrase. 保持健康；保持体型良好
words.ex: She exercises regularly to stay fit.
words.ex_cn: 她定期锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: To maintain good physical condition through regular exercise and healthy eating.

words.tr: phrase. 承担责任；负起责任
words.ex: He will take responsibility for his actions.
words.ex_cn: 他将为自己的行为负责。
words.en: To accept that you are the person who should deal with something or take care of someone.

words.tr: n. 关键人物；核心人物；重要人物
words.ex: The key figures in the report are sales and costs.
words.ex_cn: 报告中的关键数字是销售额和成本。
words.en: Important or influential people in a particular field or organization.

words.tr: v. 确定因素；查明影响某事物的原因或条件
